name: regatta
description: Regatta: an open-source Business-as-Code framework, one installable plugin per module.

plugins.name: regatta
plugins.description: The core every module builds on: shared library, model gate, cost, secrets, the regatta CLI.

plugins.name: helloworld
plugins.description: The public door: name-check and /name to name a project, helloworld to publish it through a privacy scan.

plugins.name: wharf-runs
plugins.description: Unattended runs across a fleet of Macs: Orca kept to the registry's scopes on each (needs a `scopes` tool, not yet published), and the Macs paired.

plugins.name: plumb
plugins.description: Measure: crew-report, the owner's own time per project each week, beside the model cost.

plugins.name: sextant
plugins.description: Strategy towards your North Star; today its ideas intake, Sparks: voice memos, written notes and Apple Notes in, one note per idea out.

plugins.name: lighthouse
plugins.description: Upkeep of the machines: a health pass, declared settings, several logins, shared-drive publishing, folder trust, tiling, and the guards around secrets and logins.
